Work in the background, on a queue in PostgreSQL (River): each job the model declares gets its arguments' type, with their rules, a method of its module that enqueues it (EnqueueX, and EnqueueXTx in a transaction, so that it is enqueued only if the transaction commits), and a file of yours where its work goes. The worker's run command works the queue: a job that fails is tried again later, a job is worked once even with several workers, and one with @jobs(every "...") is enqueued on that schedule.

```esquadro
blueprint jobs
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [domain](../domain/), [postgres](../postgres/), [migrations](../migrations/), [worker](../worker/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [testcontainers](../testcontainers/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workers` | int | `10` | Jobs worked at once, per queue, by each process; &lt;APP>_JOBS_WORKERS overrides it. |
| `queues` | list | `["default"]` | The queues the worker works; a job goes to default unless its @jobs(queue ...) says otherwise. |

```esquadro
blueprint jobs {
  workers 10
}
```

## Environment variables

Read when the app starts; see [Environment variables](/esquadro/language/environment/).

| Variable | Type | Value | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<APP>_JOBS_WORKERS` | int | the workers option | Jobs each queue works at once, per process. |
| `<APP>_JOBS_QUEUES` | list | the app's, from its blueprints and options | The queues the worker works, comma-separated. |

## Annotations

| Where | Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| job | `every` | string | When to enqueue the job, as cron: "0 3 * * *" (every day at 3:00), or "@every 10m", "@hourly", "@daily". Its arguments are then their defaults. |
| job | `max_attempts` | int | Attempts before the job is given up (River's default: 25). |
| job | `queue` | string | The queue it goes to: one of the blueprint's queues. |

An annotation is written `@jobs(key value)` on the element.

## Slots

Other blueprints add code at these points (see [Writing a blueprint](/esquadro/writing-blueprints/#slots)).

| Slot | |
|---|---|
| `jobs.imports` | Imports of internal/platform/jobs/jobs.go. |
| `jobs.middleware` | Code in Queue.Open that changes River's config before the client is made, e.g. config.Middleware = append(config.Middleware, ...). |
